purpose: Adult first-person continuity corpus; original voice anchors are separate. Neither a Truth Terminal corpus nor a capability claim.
selection: General adult seed paragraphs contain I/me/my/mine/myself/we/us/our/ourselves; retain immediate neighboring paragraphs for authentic context. Every general-adult chunk contains a marker. Original anchors are included unchanged whether or not each has an explicit first-person pronoun. No overlapping chunks; no concatenation over unselected paragraph gaps.
split_method: 80/10/10 deterministic chapter hash for books and whole-essay hash for Gwern BEFORE chunking; original anchor group assignments preserved.

limitations: First-person marker is a transparent lexical heuristic; retained adjacent sentences can refer to others.
Historical prose and human narrator identities dominate; sources are continuity training, not claims about machine experience.
Some public-domain works contain outdated social attitudes and historical drug/medical references.
Contemporary essay material is selected conservatively; excluded code, lists, blockquotes, footnotes, and long inline quotations.
Coverage is measured without deleting any OOV-containing sentences; actual tokenizer normalization belongs to the trainer.

excluded_acquired_sources.gwern-fiction-clippy: fiction/model-role ambiguity; not needed for authored essay corpus
excluded_acquired_sources.gwern-review-book: review collection mixes author commentary with third-party material

paragraph_boundary_policy: Excluded paragraphs and non-prose blocks create explicit breaks; no chunk crosses an excluded block.
word_count_definition: Raw source word counts use ASCII word matching; canonical normalized training-token counts are separately reported and authoritative for vocabulary coverage.

canonical_tokenizer.normalization: NFKD lowercase; curly apostrophes normalized; combining accents stripped; unsupported Unicode symbols and separators delimit words. ASCII alphabetic words with internal apostrophe and optional final .!?; raw paragraphs separately preserved.
canonical_tokenizer.vocabulary_policy: Training only: up to2000 repeated target-voice types, then frequency. Classes are contiguous64 frequency ranks.
